import numpy as np
import mir_eval

# Copy the provided reference frequencies and inject known values 
# to deterministically test the 0.0 preservation and math conversion.
test_freqs = np.copy(ref_freqs)
if test_freqs.size >= 2:
    test_freqs.flat[0] = 0.0   # Unvoiced frame, should remain 0.0
    test_freqs.flat[1] = 20.0  # Exactly 1 octave (1200 cents) above default base 10.0 Hz

cents = mir_eval.melody.hz2cents(test_freqs)

# Verify shape is preserved
assert cents.shape == test_freqs.shape

# Verify the deterministic properties of the conversion
if test_freqs.size >= 2:
    assert cents.flat[0] == 0.0, "0.0 Hz should be safely preserved as 0.0 cents"
    assert np.isclose(cents.flat[1], 1200.0), "20.0 Hz should be 1200 cents relative to 10.0 Hz base"

witness = cents.flat[:2].tolist() if cents.size >= 2 else []
print(f"__CHECK__ hz2cents {cents.shape} {witness}")
